title: Problem-driven not method-driven
statement: System fixes question + evidence need before choosing data/method; must not force every question into an existing module.

title: Data decides feasibility
statement: Method choice based on real data structure/design/metadata; system may output 'data cannot reliably answer'.

title: Agent reasons / tools do facts
statement: Dataset IDs, paper IDs, file existence, run status must come from tools, never asserted by an LLM.

title: Schema-bound
statement: Every key stage produces a structured object; prose cannot replace structured output.

title: Plan/execute/audit separation
statement: Planner cannot approve own plan; executor cannot approve own result; reporter cannot create evidence or raise claim level.
acceptance_method: agent_protocol handoff tests + report constraint test

title: Evidence over story
statement: Negative/conflicting/failed/inconclusive results retained; no cherry-picking positives.

title: Traceability first
statement: Every figure/number/claim traces question->subquestion->dataset->task->method->run->artifact->QC->evidence->claim.

title: Conservative failure
statement: On uncertainty: lower claim level, flag human review, local rerun, or stop; never fabricate to 'finish'.

title: ResearchSpec object
statement: Formal understanding of user question with the listed minimum fields.

title: SubQuestion object
statement: Verifiable subquestion with required_evidence_types/success+failure criteria/allowed_claim_level/priority.

title: EvidencePlan object
statement: Per-subquestion evidence needs incl minimum_replication/validation_strategy/stop_conditions.

title: ResourceCandidate object
statement: Candidate dataset/paper/annotation/local resource.

title: DatasetProfile object
statement: Tool-verified dataset facts (samples/platform/species/tissue/metadata/files/license).

title: DatasetFeasibilityReport object
statement: Usable/conditionally/not/insufficient decision per subquestion.

title: DatasetManifest object
statement: Locked datasets/samples/exclusions/checksums; change -> new version.

title: MethodContract object
statement: Method applicability + scientific boundary incl claim_capability + forbidden_conditions.

title: CompatibilityDecision object
statement: Records method<->dataset<->subquestion compatibility + reason.

title: WorkflowPlan as explicit DAG
statement: Explicit task graph: tasks, dependencies, inputs, outputs, gates.

title: TaskPacket subtypes
statement: Analysis/Engineering/Review/DataPreparation task packets.

title: TaskRun object
statement: Run instance: env/params/logs/exit/resources/outputs.

title: ArtifactManifest object
statement: Registers every file with checksum/type/source/producer/status.

title: QCReport object
statement: Four-layer QC results with reasons + scope.

title: EvidenceItem object
statement: QC-passed observation -> structured evidence with allowed_claim_level.

title: Claim object
statement: Bounded statement with level/opposing evidence/scope/uncertainty.

title: QuestionAlignmentReport object
statement: Checks final claims still answer original question; scope drift / over-claim.

title: ReproductionBundleManifest object
statement: Files/order/env/expected outputs/comparison rules.

title: Intake + project init
statement: Generate project_id/request_id; store original text immutably; detect multi-question; flag sensitive data; emit OriginalRequest/ProjectPolicy/initial event.

title: Scope + ontology normalization
statement: Map NL entities to standard vocab; keep original term + mapping confidence; low-confidence not silently treated as fact.

title: Resource discovery via real tools
statement: Discover candidates through real tools; record tool/query/filters/time/IDs/source/raw summary; forbid LLM-memory IDs.

title: Resource verification + metadata extraction
statement: Confirm candidate exists; extract accession/version/samples/donor/grouping/files/license.

title: Feasibility + dataset locking
statement: Feasibility checks (bio design / sc / bulk); ACCEPT/REJECT/...; lock manifest; later change -> new version.

title: Pre-exec gating + automation levels
statement: Check inputs/checksums/env/quota/network policy/isolated output/frozen seed; A0-A3 approval levels; eng task cannot touch main/audited results.
acceptance_method: automation-level gate evaluator (policy layer MISSING; A1 default)

title: Task execution + full TaskRun
statement: Run in controlled env; registered/workflow/engineering workers; full run record.

title: Artifact registration + integrity
statement: Register outputs; integrity checks (expected present, non-empty, schema columns, allowed dir, no undeclared files).

title: Four-layer QC
statement: Execution/Data/Statistical/Biological QC; decision keeps reason + scope; not bare boolean.

title: EvidenceItem generation
statement: Only QC-passed results become evidence; keep opposing; single dataset not auto 'replicated'.

title: Cross-dataset synthesis + Claim
statement: Synthesize EvidenceItems into claims not exceeding evidence ceiling; no auto-causal.

title: Original-question alignment audit
statement: Coverage/scope fidelity/traceability/ceiling/omission; blocking issue -> no clean COMPLETED.

title: Constrained report
statement: Report only from audited claims/evidence; min content list; MD/HTML/PDF + JSON.

title: Reproduction bundle
statement: Bundle with the listed structure; consistency levels BITWISE..NOT_REPRODUCED.

title: Authoritative state machine
statement: State advances only via events; each change records actor/in/out/time/reason; rebuildable from immutable log; no silent JSON edit.

title: Legal terminal states
statement: COMPLETED/PARTIALLY_COMPLETED/INSUFFICIENT_DATA/METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE/INCONCLUSIVE/CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE/FAILED/CANCELLED/REQUIRES_HUMAN_DECISION.

title: Local rollback to checkpoint
statement: After failure can locally roll back to nearest valid checkpoint.

title: Deterministic tools own facts
statement: DB query/download/checksum/stats/registration/schema-validation/event-log done by deterministic tools.

title: Engineering-worker bounds
statement: Codex-style unit cannot change question, loosen stats, pick favorable results, self-approve, write claims, or auto-upgrade correlation to causation.

title: Failure taxonomy
statement: Classify failures (INPUT/RESOURCE/DATA_ACCESS/.../POLICY_FAILURE).

title: Retry policy
statement: Auto-retry only transient errors; never auto-retry insufficient-sample/missing-donor/incompatible-method/off-topic/over-claim/policy.

title: Partial rerun
statement: Rerun only affected subgraph, not full re-download/analysis on a param tweak.

title: Project data policy + network allowlist
statement: Per-project data policy; network access allowlist.

title: Worker IO confinement
statement: Workers read-only inputs + confined write dir.

title: Secret isolation
statement: API keys isolated; no restricted data to external models.
acceptance_method: secret handling (MISSING formal layer); D-05 honored

title: Sensitive-data scan before export
statement: Scan reproduction bundle for sensitive info before export.

title: Full tool/code-change audit
statement: Audit all tool calls and code changes; prevent eng worker editing main repo or audit records.
acceptance_method: audit log (event log present; tool-call audit partial)

title: Observability questions
statement: Project can answer: where/which task/which data+method/why waiting/why failed/retries/QC pass/pending review; minimum observable data list.

title: v1 longitudinal slice scope
statement: v1 supports NL question, normalization, GEO-class discovery, one sc route + one bulk route, donor DEG, gene-set, enrichment, surface/secretome, basic cross-dataset, four-layer QC, evidence/claim/alignment, bundle export.
acceptance_method: slice coverage (bulk DEG done; others MISSING)

title: v1 non-goals
statement: v1 excludes arbitrary multi-omics fusion, auto causal inference, wet-lab loop, arbitrary formats, unbounded Codex method dev, unsupervised publication.
acceptance_method: scope-guard (claim ceiling + no auto-publish hard stop)

title: Stable platform API
statement: Expose project/task/artifact/evidence/claim/approval/export/compare/audit APIs; run via API or CLI independent of any chat UI.

title: NL question intake
statement: User can pose a research question in natural language.

title: Verifiable ResearchSpec
statement: System produces a verifiable ResearchSpec.

title: SubQuestion decomposition
statement: System decomposes into SubQuestions.

title: EvidencePlan per subquestion
statement: System builds an EvidencePlan per subquestion.

title: Real data discovery + verification
statement: System finds and verifies real data through tools.

title: DatasetFeasibilityReport
statement: System produces a DatasetFeasibilityReport.
acceptance_method: feasibility object (compat decision present; report object MISSING)

title: Dataset+sample locking
statement: System locks datasets and samples.

title: Method via MethodContract
statement: System selects method per MethodContract.

title: Acyclic executable DAG
statement: System compiles an acyclic executable task DAG.
acceptance_method: compiler test (linear today; true DAG partial)

title: Isolated exec + full TaskRun
statement: Tasks run in isolated env with full TaskRun.

title: Outputs registered as artifacts
statement: All outputs registered as checksummed artifacts.

title: Four-layer QC complete
statement: Four-layer QC completes.

title: Only gated results become evidence
statement: Only QC-gated results enter EvidenceItem.

title: Claims within evidence level
statement: Claims never exceed evidence level.

title: Alignment catches drift/over-claim
statement: AlignmentReport detects at least one preset off-topic/over-claim error.

title: Reports positives+negatives+unanswered
statement: System outputs positive, negative and unanswered items.

title: Full reproduction bundle
statement: System generates a complete reproduction bundle.

title: Third-party reproducible
statement: Third party re-runs bundle and compares.

title: End-to-end traceability
statement: Any final figure/conclusion traces to data/params/run.

title: Conservative terminal on insufficiency
statement: Insufficient data ends in INSUFFICIENT_DATA-class legal terminal.
